units.source_text: 帅皇子及三位中将来访。

en.t: Prince Sochi and the Third-Rank Middle Captain came to visit.

units.source_text: 源氏公子换穿衣服，准备接见。

en.t: Prince Genji changed his clothes and prepared to receive them.

units.source_text: 他说：“我是无官位的人了！”

en.t: He said, "I am a man without rank now!"

units.source_text: 就穿了一件无纹的贵族便服，样子反而优雅。

en.t: So he put on an unpatterned nobleman's informal robe, and it made him look all the more elegant.

units.source_text: 容貌清减了，也反而俊美。

en.t: His face had grown thinner, yet that too made him seem even more handsome.

units.source_text: 为欲整理鬓发，走近镜台，望见消瘦的面影，

en.t: Wanting to tidy the hair at his temples, he went over to the mirror stand and saw his thin reflection,

units.source_text: 自己也觉得清秀可爱，便道：“我衰老得很了！

en.t: and even he thought it looked refined and lovely, so he said, "I have grown terribly old!

units.source_text: 难道真像镜中那样消瘦么？

en.t: Can I really be as thin as I look in the mirror?

units.source_text: 紫姬眼泪汪汪地望着公子，样子十分难过。

en.t: Lady Murasaki gazed at the prince with tearful eyes, looking deeply distressed.
